info.title: ByKaranteli crypto derivatives data
info.description: Crypto derivatives market structure recorded around the clock. Live snapshots are free with an account key; the endpoints listed here sell depth and history per call over the x402 protocol.
info.x-guidance: Each /api/x402/* endpoint answers HTTP 402 with machine-readable payment requirements and settles in USDC on Solana or Base per successful response; a failed response settles nothing. Query parameters narrow the rows (symbol, exchange, from, to, limit where listed); the free GET /api/x402 returns the same catalog with prices and parameters.

get.summary: Fetch the multi-exchange liquidation map for one perp
get.description: Full multi-exchange liquidation map snapshot for a Binance USDT-M perp: modeled leverage clusters, real forceOrder levels, top magnets, funding, OI and orderbook context.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker covered by LiqMap, e.g. BTC, ETH or SOL, with or without the USDT suffix (default BTC); the list is at https://bykaranteli.com/liqmap

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Lookback window for the position model: 1h, 4h, 12h, 24h, 3d, 1w or 30d (default 24h)

parameters.name: leverage
parameters.description: Leverage group, default all: all, low (5x and 10x), medium (25x) or high (50x and 100x)

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: One venue's model instead of the multi-venue merge, default all: all, binance, bybit, okx, gate, htx or hyperliquid

200.description: Requested data, returned after payment settles

402.description: Payment required: the response carries x402 payment requirements

get.summary: Fetch Bitcoin cycle indicator crossings with forward returns
get.description: Every day since 2012 on which a Bitcoin cycle indicator crossed a canonical band (Pi Cycle top cross and reset, Mayer Multiple 2.4 and 0.8, Puell Multiple 4 and 0.5, 200-week MA, 2-year MA x5, golden ratio 1.6/2/3/5, profitable days 95% and 50%), with the BTC close on the day and the forward 7, 30, 90, 180 and 365-day returns that followed. Computed over recorded daily closes (Bitstamp 2012-2017, Binance since); the free endpoint carries the levels without the event tape or forward returns.

get.summary: Fetch minute history of the Turkey premium index
get.description: Minute history of the Turkey premium index (2026-09-17): the TRY and USDT reference prices built from Turkish spot venues (BtcTurk, Bitlo, CoinTR, OKX TR, Binance TR, Bybit TR, KuCoin TR, Bitexen) as the median mid of eligible books, with eligible and observed venue counts, status, the Binance global USDT price, the ECB USD/TRY fix, the premium in basis points and index_bps, the Turkey Premium Index (total premium against the official rate; the 0-100 score is a fixed published reading of it); optionally the per-venue book rows (best bid and ask, spread, depth within 10 to 100 bps, censoring flag) with exchange=<venue>. The free /api/public/turkey-premium returns the live board and 15-minute points for up to 30 days.

get.summary: Fetch hourly insurance fund readings per venue pool
get.description: Hourly insurance fund readings per pool on Binance, Bybit, OKX, Gate, MEXC, Bitfinex, Crypto.com, Delta Exchange, dYdX and Paradex: venue, pool (the contracts a pool covers, OKX's instrument family and its published venue total as pool total, a MEXC contract or other for the contracts folded together, a Bitfinex collateral currency, a Delta Exchange asset, or the single fund of Crypto.com, dYdX and Paradex), asset, balance in the asset, USD value (dollar stables 1:1, other assets at our recorded price, null when unpriced) and the number of contracts the pool covers, recorded on our side from 2026-09-23 and kept 35 days. The free /api/public/insurance-funds returns the latest reading and daily closes per venue; the free insurance-funds-daily file carries one row per day, venue and asset.

get.summary: Fetch hourly tokenized stock wrapper prices and premiums
get.description: Hourly readings per tokenized stock wrapper from xStocks, Robinhood Stock Tokens, Coinbase Tokenized Stocks, Binance bStocks, Ondo Stocks, Backpack Securities, Reality (Bitget), Superstate Opening Bell and Figure: the wrapper price (liquidity-weighted median of admitted DEX pools, or the volume-weighted exchange price under chain cex), the real share reference and its session state, the premium in percent, pool liquidity, 24h volume and admitted pools, recorded on our side from 2026-09-23 and kept permanently. The free /api/public/tokenized-stocks returns the latest board, where each wrapper's price_source names the price that valued its supply dollars (reference, issuer_oracle, wrapper, or null when unpriced) and totals.priced_by counts the wrappers per level; the free tokenized-stocks-daily file carries one close per wrapper and day with price_source as its last column.
